name: Mystery's Gambit
author: FRO_PWR
summary: Mimics the effects of three random gambits (including modded gambits).
description: A rare utility gambit that is three gambits in a trench coat. When it enters play it picks three random gambits from everything the game knows about - vanilla and modded alike - and quietly runs their effects as its own. Selling it triggers each hidden gambit's sell behaviour before the whole bundle disappears. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
